verdict.rationale: Ashby's own docs describe a native AI Notetaker add-on that records, transcribes, and summarizes interviews and says it is designed to help deliver higher-quality feedback. That covers the core capture-and-summary part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows summaries being distilled into the scorecard, and nothing covers candidate consent; the notetaker's permission controls govern internal user access, not candidate consent. Missing for 10: documented distillation of summaries into scorecards, candidate consent/notification handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews get AI notes and summaries — recorded, transcribed, and distilled into the scorecard with candidate consent handled

citations.quote: Ashby's native AI Notetaker records, transcribes, and summarizes your interviews.
Designed so you can fully engage candidates, deliver higher-quality feedback, and make faster, more confident hiring decisions.
Roll out to all your interviews. No extra steps, new tools to learn, or extra admin work.
